data.name: Tactical Response Team
data.detailed_description:
When the police and other law enforcement agencies run out of options, the Tactical Response Team steps in to restore law and order. No challenge is too great, no mission too dangerous, and the innocent must be protected.

As a T.R.T. team leader, you and your skilled group of operators will go on missions that will decide between life and death. Use modern weapons, high-quality tools, electronic gadgets, and even drones to save lives and take down criminals.

When the situation is hopeless! When all other options have failed! When it's a matter of life and death! When the police special forces can no longer control the situation!

Then there is only one answer: T.R.T.

Tactical Response Team (T.R.T.) is a third-person shooter in which you take on the role of an elite police force team leader and throw yourself into intense, mission-based operations full of excitement, strategy, and firepower. Every decision can mean the difference between life and death.

Missions:

Bank Robbery - A red button under the counter. A finger that presses it. No one notices the silent alarm. And when the blue lights and sirens appear in front of the bank, the bank robbery turns into a shootout with hostages taken. Hours later, when the smoke clears and the operation is over, all the hostages are free. The bank robbers and hostage-takers have been arrested or eliminated. The Tactical Response Team has restored law and order.

Hostage situation - The gun pointed at the girl's head means death in the worst case scenario. She knows it, the hostage taker knows it, and so does the T.R.T. operator lying on the roof with his sniper rifle. A typical T.R.T. operation where you can decide how your team proceeds: shoot or use tactics. Save the hostage!

Arrest - The cartel boss has already evaded arrest by police units three times. The T.R.T. will make sure there isn't a fourth time. Explore the area and the hideout. Organize the raid and make sure there won't be a fifth attempt.

Many more missions will follow – thanks to Early Access, you can help decide where the Tactical Response Team's journey will take them!

 

Early Access Features:

  • Singleplayer focused police shooter

  • Adrenaline-fueled fun – enjoyment and entertainment are the main focus

  • Mission driven playstyle starting with bank robbery, hostage rescues, and arrests

  • Various weapons and tools – from tasers to pistols, shotguns to assault rifles, explosives to drones

  • Team tactics – plan your route and give orders to your team

  • Hightech Gadgets like drone

Why Early Access:

We have been developing police simulation video games for years. We have realized that working with our community helps us develop a better game for players. We have also seen some requests from the community that were too late for us to fulfill.

That's why we decided to launch early access for our new project and create a better experience for our community.

 

We plan to use Steam boards and Discord servers to communicate with players and gather feedback so we can improve the gaming experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: integrated or dedicated compatible soundcard
  • Additional Notes: System Requirements might change during further Development. Installation on an SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
